decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Painter's Servant to change all cards in the opponent's deck to a chosen color, allowing for powerful combos with cards like Grindstone to mill out the opponent quickly. The deck also includes various ways to protect and recur key combo pieces, as well as disruption to control the game. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan to win the game through a fast and efficient win condition.

The main idea of this Grixis Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt and control the opponent while also applying pressure with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler. Utilizing cards like Force of Will, Daze, and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to quickly close out the game with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and efficient creatures. Mishra's Bauble provides card selection and synergy with the deck's game plan, while Ponder and Brainstorm help dig for key cards and keep the aggression going.

The main concept of this deck is to have a fast and aggressive start in order to put pressure on the opponent early on. The deck focuses on playing efficient and disruptive creatures like Archon of Emeria and Anointed Peacekeeper while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Elite Spellbinder. The deck also utilizes fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Lotus Petal to help accelerate its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and dictate the pace of the game through its aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The key concept of this deck is to create a powerful combo using Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Painter's Servant. By utilizing these cards, the deck aims to manipulate the color of all permanents on the battlefield, enabling other cards like Grindstone to mill the opponent's deck and potentially win the game. The deck also includes support cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Orcish Bowmasters, and Fury to further enhance the combo. It also features powerful spells like Reanimate, Pyroblast, and Red Elemental Blast to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining control of the game.

This aggressive Legacy deck focuses on utilizing the Death's Shadow creature to its full potential by lowering the player's life total and boosting Death's Shadow's power. The deck includes cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's hand, while also providing removal spells like Fury and Angrath's Rampage to maintain board control. Reanimate is used to bring back key creatures from the graveyard, while cards like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Seasoned Pyromancer provide additional threats to overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total and close out the game with powerful threats.

This mono black combo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Hymn to Tourach while utilizing Leyline of the Void to shut down graveyard strategies. The key concept revolves around using Helm of Obedience as a win condition alongside Dauthi Voidwalker and other threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and offers additional disruption with cards like Opposition Agent and Plague Engineer. The deck aims to control the game early on and win with a powerful combo finish.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a large amount of mana through the Cloudpost lands and then use that mana to play powerful creatures and disrupt the opponent. This deck focuses on using cards like Elvish Reclaimer, Crop Rotation, and Expedition Map to search for the Cloudpost lands and combo pieces like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a large threat on the board. It also includes cards like Primeval Titan, Once Upon a Time, and Green Sun's Zenith to find and play specific creatures to either win the game or control the board.

The deck is focused on quickly and efficiently executing a combo that involves milling the entire deck into the graveyard, then using a reanimation spell to bring back an important creature like Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck utilizes fast mana like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide, along with powerful tutoring spells like Pact of Negation and Summoner's Pact, to quickly assemble the combo pieces and protect them. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on fast mana acceleration and disruption through cards like Simian Spirit Guide, Chrome Mox, and Chalice of the Void to slow down the opponent's game plan. It also utilizes aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to pressure the opponent while locking down their mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Trinisphere. By limiting the opponent's resources and applying pressure with efficient threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly before they can recover.

This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing a threatening board presence with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent. By combining disruptive spells like Daze, Force of Will, and Thoughtseize with powerful removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to control the tempo of the game while dealing consistent damage to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Lórien Revealed and Mishra's Bauble help to smooth out draws and provide additional value, while the mana base is optimized to support the deck's aggressive game plan.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly deploy threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo advantage through efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push. The manabase is designed to support the aggressive game plan with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck focuses on being proactive and controlling the game to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on quickly putting big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand into play using spells like Entomb, Shallow Grave, and Reanimate. It also includes card draw, disruption, and protection spells like Brainstorm, Veil of Summer, and Daze to help the player survive long enough to execute the combo. The deck aims to win the game through powerful creatures that can overwhelm the opponent and win in a single turn.

The main focus of this UWx Control deck is to effectively control the game by utilizing countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Brainstorm, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also includes board wipe spells like Supreme Verdict and Lórien Revealed to deal with creature-heavy strategies. Additionally, the deck has some versatility with cards like Dress Down and Prismatic Ending to handle a variety of threats. Overall, the key concept is to control the board and outvalue the opponent.
